state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 3 (the call) is under way.** Stages 1 and 2 are on disk. The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*. This goal has no record slot.

`nvs_ext::convert` (behind `engine`) converts every row of `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`'s table to its WIT value and back. The handle rows go through the call's `convert::Crossing`: `mixed` is lent through `nvs_ext::handle`, and a resource a guest returns is kept under a request-wide number and dropped by `Request::end` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs` module doc). `crates/nvs-ext/tests/convert.rs` has all 9 of its check's tests.

The checker (`crates/nvs-types/src/ext_lib.rs`) marks each loaded class `ClassSignature::extension`, and every `ResolvedCall` to one carries `extension: true`. `nvs-ir` lowers such a static call to one `InstKind::ExtensionCall { class, method, args }`, arguments borrowed as a `CoreCall`'s are (`crates/nvs-ir/src/ir.rs`, its doc). Codegen has no arm for it: `emit.rs` refuses it as `CodegenError::Unsupported("a call into an extension")`, so a program calling an extension type-checks, lowers, and then stops in codegen. No host calls `Request::end` yet.

Fixture gaps, Stage 3's: the named rows are absent from the conformance fixture under `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/`, and `kindOf` (`mixed`) is never called.

items.text: **The trampoline in codegen and the runtime**: an `InstKind::ExtensionCall` (`crates/nvs-ir/src/ir.rs`) compiles to a direct call of a per-export trampoline that converts the runtime's values to `nvs_ext::convert::Value` by the manifest's declared types, runs `Request::call_values` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:526`) on the request's coroutine, and raises a `Failure::outcome`; the request's end runs `Request::end` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:631`). Replace the refusal at `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:1072` with an arm beside `CoreCall`'s at `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:644`. `rule:packaging/a-guest-crash-throws`, `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

**The two end-to-end cases**: `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-call-crosses-every-row-of-the-value-table.nvst` and `tests/conformance/ext/an-extension-error-throws-its-class-and-a-trap-throws-extension-error.nvst`, loading the fixture through `--EXTENSION--`; add the named rows and a `mixed` call to the fixture under `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs:1`. `rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`.

`bytes` crosses as one `Val::U8` per byte, and `call_values` parses the method's types on every call, until the trampoline lowers through a typed function: `nvs_ext::convert`'s and `nvs_ext::call`'s module docs.
